Key Responsibilities Construction Supervision Supervise all piping installation and erection activities for onshore and offshore oil & gas facilities. Ensure piping works are executed in compliance with approved IFC drawings, specifications, method statements, and project requirements. Coordinate piping construction activities with Civil, Mechanical, Structural, Electrical, Instrumentation, and Commissioning teams. Execution & Coordination Manage and supervise contractor and subcontractor piping teams. Ensure availability of manpower, tools, equipment, and materials required for construction activities. Review work packs, construction schedules, and fabrication priorities. Resolve site-related construction issues and coordinate engineering clarifications. Interface with vendors and technical specialists regarding piping systems and equipment connections. Welding & Testing Monitor piping fabrication and welding activities to ensure compliance with approved WPS/PQR and project specifications. Coordinate hydrostatic testing, pneumatic testing, flushing, air blowing, and reinstatement activities. Ensure proper preservation and cleanliness requirements are maintained during construction. Conduct toolbox talks, safety inspections, and risk assessments. Monitor lifting operations, hot work activities, confined space entry, and work-at-height compliance. Assist project management in developing recovery plans when required. Track construction milestones and completion targets. Commissioning Support Support Mechanical Completion (MC) and Ready for Commissioning (RFC) activities. Ensure timely turnover of piping systems to commissioning teams. Participate in walkdowns, punch-list verification, and system handovers. Coordinate reinstatement activities following testing and inspection.
